title: Premium Pricing Rules for Utility Line Protection Plans
content:
# Premium Pricing Rules

Billing Operations rule for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

A monthly-billed plan is charged the plan's monthly premium per billing period, each period starting on the same calendar day of the month as the term start date (the last day of the month when that day does not exist) and due on its start. An annual-billed plan is charged once per term on the term start date twelve monthly premiums reduced by the plan's up-front discount rate, rounded to the cent. Renewal terms are priced at the parameters in force on the new term start. A returned payment is billed back as a returned payment charge plus one returned payment fee charge. Premium is billed only while the plan status is waiting period, active or suspended for nonpayment.

## The annual premium in words

The annual premium is twelve times the monthly premium, reduced by the discount rate (the discount being that fraction of the twelve monthly premiums), and the result is rounded to the cent once.

*Hypothetical worked example (figures chosen for illustration, not a plan's price):* a monthly premium of $10.00 and a discount rate of 0.08. Twelve monthly premiums are $120.00; the discount is 0.08 of $120.00, which is $9.60; the annual premium charged on the term start date is $110.40.

## Monthly billing periods

| Term start date falls on | Each monthly period starts on | Due date |
|---|---|---|
| the 12th of a month (hypothetical) | the 12th of every month | the period's start |
| the 31st of a month (hypothetical) | the 31st, or the last day of any month that has no 31st | the period's start |

## When premium may be billed

| Plan status | Premium billed |
|---|---|
| waiting period | yes |
| active | yes |
| suspended for nonpayment | yes |

Premium is billed only in these three statuses; the status is read from Bridgewell's plan record.

## Returned payments

A returned payment produces two charges: the returned payment charged back, and one returned payment fee charge at the plan's returned payment fee.

## Renewal pricing

A renewal term is priced at the parameters in force on the day the new term starts.
